questions.title: Who will win stage 11 of the 2026 Tour de France?
questions.background: The Tour de France awards individual stage victories separately from the overall race title.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The race organizer’s official stage 11 classification, corroborated by contemporaneous reputable sports reporting.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the rider officially classified as the winner of stage 11 of the 2026 Tour de France, including any penalties applied when the stage results are confirmed.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning rider’s full name.

questions.title: Who will hold the men's outdoor mile world record immediately after the 2026 London Diamond League meeting?
questions.background: The London meeting is part of the annual Diamond League track-and-field series.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: World Athletics reports or reputable contemporaneous news coverage of the London Diamond League meeting on July 18, 2026.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the athlete credited as the men's outdoor mile world-record holder at the conclusion of the meeting. If no new world record is set, resolve to the existing record holder. Later administrative ratification is not required if the performance is reported as a world record.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The athlete's full name.

questions.title: Which country will win the men's team gymnastics gold medal at the 2026 Commonwealth Games?
questions.background: The Commonwealth Games men's team gymnastics competition awards medals according to the final team standings.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official Commonwealth Games results, corroborated by contemporary reliable news reporting.
  • Resolution Condition: Resolve to the country awarded gold in the men's team gymnastics competition at the 2026 Commonwealth Games, once the final standings are announced.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the winning country.
questions.accepted_format: The name of the winning country.

questions.title: Who will top the men's javelin throw qualification standings at the 2026 Commonwealth Games?
questions.background: The men's javelin throw competition includes a qualifying round before the final.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official Games results for the overall men's javelin throw qualification at the 2026 Commonwealth Games
  • Resolution Date: July 30, 2026
  • Accepted Answer Format: Full name of the athlete ranked first in the overall men's javelin throw qualification results
questions.accepted_format: Full name of the athlete ranked first in the overall men's javelin throw qualification results

questions.title: Who will win the men's javelin throw gold medal at the 2026 Commonwealth Games?
questions.background: The 2026 Commonwealth Games are scheduled to take place in Glasgow, Scotland.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official Commonwealth Games results or reliable contemporaneous reporting identifying the gold medallist in the 2026 men's javelin throw final.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the athlete declared the gold medallist at the conclusion of the final. Subsequent medal reallocations will not affect resolution.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The gold medallist's full name.

questions.title: Which country will finish top of Pool D at the 2026 men's Hockey World Cup?
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The official tournament standings for Pool D, corroborated by contemporaneous reporting.
  • Resolution: Resolve once all Pool D matches in the initial pool stage have concluded in August 2026. Use the country ranked first under the tournament's official standings and tiebreaking rules.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the country finishing first in Pool D.

questions.title: Who will win the men's 400m hurdles at the 2026 Silesia Diamond League meeting?
questions.background: The 400m hurdles is a one-lap track race in which athletes clear hurdles in assigned lanes.
questions.resolution_criteria: Resolve according to the official Diamond League results for the men's 400m hurdles at the 2026 Silesia meeting. The answer must be the full name of the athlete officially classified in first place in that race, not the overall season champion.
questions.accepted_format: Resolve according to the official Diamond League results for the men's 400m hurdles at the 2026 Silesia meeting. The answer must be the full name of the athlete officially classified in first place in that race, not the overall season champion.
